Adminer 6.2.0

Official stable release, published 2026-10-23:
https://github.com/vrana/adminer/releases/tag/v6.2.0

Unmodified all-database, all-language release artifact:
https://github.com/vrana/adminer/releases/download/v6.2.0/adminer-6.2.0.php

SHA-256:
9047c00dfc8258c6046c6720d7d201eaa0ca016fa0fc554bf0c4c137306e1c16

This digest matches the release asset digest returned by:
https://api.github.com/repos/vrana/adminer/releases/latest

Verified on 2026-10-30. The official core is stored as vendor/adminer/adminer.php.
The root index.php uses upstream plugin discovery. The root adminer.php uses
upstream's adminer_object() factory hook to bypass the custom plugin stack.
Both entrypoints require the vendor directory when deployed.

The previous index.php was identical to the official adminer-5.3.0-en.php
artifact. No embedded loader customization was carried into this release.
The previous standalone adminer.php was version 4.8.1.
